# CMR non-stress (cardiomyopathy / viability) — Dr Eleanor Marsh (fictional)

Consultant cardiac radiologist at a fictional tertiary cardiothoracic centre. Full, measured prose under colon headers
(Clinical details / Technique / Findings / Tissue characterisation / Late gadolinium enhancement / Conclusion).
Quotes indexed values in a fixed string with local mapping reference ranges; says "preserved" and "impaired", never "normal"/"reduced" for function.
Conclusion is a single unnumbered line when normal, numbered when abnormal, ending with a "Suggest ..." recommendation.
Lists absent ventricular values at the top of Findings; drops the tissue characterisation section on viability-only protocols.
